\section[(dialogue)]{More describing words and time — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R133-first-pass-more-describing-words-and-time}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to tell; to count and to walk.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item nice, kind, serious, right, wrong
  \item ready, safe; sure, dangerous, wet, dry
  \item cool; fresh, soft, hard, round, wide
  \item narrow, angry, bitter, salty, light
  \item heavy, thin, pleased, the weekend, a date
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Nice? (\textbf{simpático}.) Kind? (\textbf{gentil}.) Serious? (\textbf{sério}.) Right? (\textbf{certo}.) Wrong? (\textbf{errado}.) Ready? (\textbf{pronto}.) Safe; sure? (\textbf{seguro}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{perigoso}.) Wet? (\textbf{molhado}.) Dry? (\textbf{seco}.) Cool; fresh? (\textbf{fresco}.) Soft? (\textbf{macio}.) Hard? (\textbf{duro}.) Round? (\textbf{redondo}.) Wide? (\textbf{largo}.) Narrow? (\textbf{estreito}.) Angry? (\textbf{zangado}.) Bitter? (\textbf{amargo}.) Salty? (\textbf{salgado}.) Light? (\textbf{leve}.) Heavy? (\textbf{pesado}.) Thin? (\textbf{magro}.) Pleased? (\textbf{contente}.) The weekend? (\textbf{o fim de semana}.) A date? (\textbf{a data}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Numbers and verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R133-second-pass-numbers-and-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a century and often.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a century, often, sometimes, to listen, to look
  \item sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, to begin
  \item to visit, to put, to believe, to drive, to get dressed
  \item to wash, to get up, to sit down, to fall, to go up
  \item to go down, to rent, to repair; to notice, to tell; to count, to walk
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A century? (\textbf{o século}.) Often? (\textbf{muitas vezes}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{às vezes}.) To listen? (\textbf{escutar}.) To look? (\textbf{olhar}.) Sixty? (\textbf{sessenta}.) Seventy? (\textbf{setenta}.) Eighty? (\textbf{oitenta}.) Ninety? (\textbf{noventa}.) To begin? (\textbf{começar}.) To visit? (\textbf{visitar}.) To put? (\textbf{pôr}.) To believe? (\textbf{acreditar}.) To drive? (\textbf{conduzir}.) To get dressed? (\textbf{vestir-se}.) To wash? (\textbf{lavar-se}.) To get up? (\textbf{levantar-se}.) To sit down? (\textbf{sentar-se}.) To fall? (\textbf{cair}.) To go up? (\textbf{subir}.) To go down? (\textbf{descer}.) To rent? (\textbf{alugar}.) To repair; to notice? (\textbf{reparar}.) To tell; to count? (\textbf{contar}.) To walk? (\textbf{caminhar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
